claim: A causally lagged deterioration in actual initial unemployment claims should identify periods when small caps underperform large caps after switching costs.

source.publisher_path: U.S. Department of Labor ETA via FRED public CSV
source.causal_lag: signal observation becomes eligible only on first U.S. trading session strictly after observation_date + 5 calendar days; this is more conservative than the Thursday 8:30 ET release and avoids same-release-day execution
source.revision_guard: use a 2-observation additional lag inside the signal so the weekly prior-value revision is known before use

signal.measure: 4-week sum of ICNSA divided by the 4-week sum 52 observations earlier
signal.hold: until next causally eligible weekly state

controls.matched_static: IWM/SPY static mix at full-sample mean IWM exposure

pass_gate: full matched_excess_cagr > 0 AND full spy_excess_cagr > 0 AND at least 3 of 4 chronology folds have matched_excess_cagr > 0
